anomalies.description: A red sedan (license plate Y692EH 50) is struck from behind or sideswiped, resulting in visible fire erupting from its rear left side; the vehicle remains stationary with flames intensifying over several seconds while traffic flows around it.

Vehicle loses control on icy road, veers sharply right off the road, and impacts snowbank/embankment, resulting in violent rotation and complete loss of visibility as windshield is obscured by snow/debris and camera orientation is disrupted.

A silver sedan (appears to be a Lada) abruptly swerves left across the lane, colliding with or narrowly missing the dashcam vehicle; debris is visible in the air and on the road immediately after the maneuver.

A dark-colored SUV approaches from the opposite direction on a snow-covered road, then veers sharply left across the centerline and collides with or strikes a large fallen tree/branch lying across the road, causing visible impact debris and abrupt deceleration.
